name: chat-by-default
description: Opens chatgpt.com in Chat instead of Work.

scripts.prebuild: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm format
scripts.build: pnpm run build:chrome && pnpm run build:firefox && pnpm run build:safari
scripts.package:chrome: mkdir -p artifacts/chrome && rm -f artifacts/chrome/chat-by-default-chrome.zip && cd dist/chrome && zip -qr ../../artifacts/chrome/chat-by-default-chrome.zip .
scripts.sign:firefox: rm -f artifacts/firefox/*.xpi && web-ext sign --source-dir=dist/firefox --artifacts-dir=artifacts/firefox --channel=unlisted && mv artifacts/firefox/*.xpi artifacts/firefox/chat-by-default-firefox.xpi

author: Joshua Rogers (@MegaManSec)
